title: Phalloidin Immunofluorescence Staining
author: Dania Villarnovo
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.read3ae
materials: -Mix cells thoroughly by pipetting up and down.
Fascin-1/Alpha-tubulin + Phalloidin + DAPI Immnofluorescence Staining Protocol
-2x Phalloidin (Abcam Alexa-Fluor 488, 176753) conjugate working solution: 2 uL of 1000x Phalloidin + 1 mL of 1x PBS w/ 1% BSA (10 mg/mL)
-1.5 ug/mL DAPI (Thermo Scientific, 62247) in 1x PBS: 4.5 uL of 1 mg/mL stock + 3 mL of 1x PBS
-Mouse anti-fascin-1 primary antibody (Santa Cruz (55K-2), sc-21743) solution: 1:500 dilution
-Mouse anti-alpha-tubulin primary antibody (Sigma-Aldrich, T5168) solution: 1:500 dilution
-Goat anti-mouse secondary antibody (Abcam Alexa-Fluor 647, 150119) solution: 1:500 dilution

steps.title: Prepare Reagents
steps.instruction: Prepare the necessary solutions for staining using the following formulations:

substeps.instruction: 3% formaldehyde in 1x PBS: Mix 4.1 mL of 36.5% stock with 45.9 mL of 1x PBS
0.5% Triton X-100: Mix 250 uL of Triton X-100 with 50 mL of 1x PBS
2x Phalloidin conjugate working solution: Mix 2 uL of 1000x Phalloidin with 1 mL of 1x PBS containing 1% BSA (10 mg/mL)
1 ug/mL DAPI in 1x PBS: Mix 3 uL of 1 mg/mL stock with 3 mL of 1x PBS OR 0.6 uL of 5 mg/mL stock with 3 mL of 1x PBS
Blocking solution (1% BSA in 1x PBS): Mix 10 mg BSA with 1 mL of 1x PBS

steps.title: Collect and Prepare Cells
steps.instruction: Harvest cells from treatment wells and prepare slides.

substeps.instruction: Remove ~100 uL aliquot from each treatment well and place in a small tube
Allow cells to settle to the bottom of the tube for ~1 hr
Apply cells from the bottom of the tube onto the center of a slide using a pipette
Spread cells with the pipette tip and allow slides to air dry

steps.title: Fix Cells
steps.instruction: Fix the cells on the slides using formaldehyde.

substeps.instruction: Add 3% formaldehyde (methanol-free) in 1x PBS to the top of each slide for 30 min
Add 0.5% Triton X-100 in 1x PBS for 5 min

steps.title: Primary Antibody Staining
steps.instruction: Apply primary antibody to the slides.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 uL of primary antibody solution per slide for 1 hr

steps.title: Secondary Antibody Staining
steps.instruction: Apply secondary antibody to the slides in the dark.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 uL of secondary antibody solution per slide for 1 hr

steps.title: Phalloidin Staining
steps.instruction: Stain cells with phalloidin in the dark.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 uL of phalloidin per slide for 2 hrs

steps.title: DAPI Staining
steps.instruction: Stain cells with DAPI in the dark.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 uL of DAPI per slide for 10 min

steps.title: Mount Slides
steps.instruction: Mount the stained slides for imaging.

substeps.instruction: Add 1-2 drops of Vectashield mounting medium (Vector labs, H-1000)
Apply nail polish to the edges
